## Resume instructions (if the operating session ends mid-window)

- The driver is session-independent (`setsid nohup`, run-root
  `/var/lib/hh/runs/run-root-p4c`). If the VM reaches TERMINATED via the
  watcher: `gcloud compute instances start hh-p4-p4c
  --project hh-p4-a1b2c3 --zone us-central1-a` (the ≤ 1 h restart
  allowance), then harvest + teardown per the recipe — verify the
  run-root is non-empty before delete (the fail-closed leg now owns
  this). Never `instances stop` mid-window — in-flight slots and the
  minting driver die with it.

  via `p4c-launch.sh go`; launch wrapper verbatim at

## Infra intervention 2026-11-25T01:00Z (recorded verbatim — coordinator)

At ~00:50Z polling showed settle cadence collapse (51→52 in ~40 min) with the driver
alive. Inspection found three `hh-l1-drive` children far past the declared
`slot_deadline_s` 3,738 s with their stores silent — the DF-R7.3-3 signature
(`reap()` never fences running members): `p4c-baseline-gpt2-codegolf-r1`
(3 h 40 m elapsed, last WAL write 21:26Z — 3 h 34 m stale),
`p4c-V1-kv-store-grpc-r1` (2 h 22 m, last write 22:48Z — 2 h 11 m stale),
`p4c-V1-merge-diff-arc-agi-task-r1` (2 h 09 m, last write 22:52Z — 2 h 08 m stale);
the proxy stayed responsive (401 on `/v1/models` without a slot token).
Coordinator intervention (recorded, not silent): `sudo kill -TERM` to PIDs
47045 / 101004 / 112335 at ~01:00Z — all three exited; the driver reaped each as
an honest `rc:-15` `slot-result.json` with the verifier scoring committed
workspace state (rewards 0/0/0). Admission resumed immediately; settle cadence
recovered to ~20/h (52 → 73 by 01:52Z). The three fenced slots are part of the
honest matrix — counted neither as passes nor clean subject failures. DF-R7.3-3
remains the live machinery gap (second live occurrence); its unblocker (a
deadline fence in `reap()`) is unchanged.
